description: This file defines a UserService class in a Java Spring application, providing methods to read user information from the repository and convert entities to DTOs.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class for handling user-related operations, including retrieving user data and handling exceptions when users are not found.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a User by identification number, throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of User DTOs.
